one_liner: AI-to-human field task marketplace for proof-based B2B verification work
problem: AI agents can plan and reason but cannot physically verify real-world conditions -- shelf placement, property condition, delivery confirmation. The gap between AI capability and physical verification is growing, and no API-native platform exists to bridge it.
solution: A verticalized two-sided marketplace connecting AI agents and businesses with verified local humans who execute field tasks (retail audits, property checks, local logistics, event verification) and return structured, GPS-validated proof.
icp: Amazon FBA sellers doing $50k+/yr needing retail shelf verification across multiple locations; solar installation companies doing 50+ installs/yr needing pre-site qualification; real estate investors managing 20+ properties remotely needing on-demand visual checks; AI agent developers building autonomous workflows that require real-world verification steps.

revenue_model.primary: 18% platform take rate on completed tasks (avg $35/task = $6.30/task)
revenue_model.secondary: API subscriptions: Starter $49/mo (50 tasks), Growth $149/mo (500 tasks), Enterprise custom
revenue_model.margin_plays: Express payout fee ($1.50/instant), premium worker placement ($4.99/wk)
revenue_model.pricing_hypothesis: $49/mo Starter tier for businesses, 18% take rate competitive with TaskRabbit (15%) and Uber (25-30%)
revenue_model.gross_margin_per_task: 77.5% on platform fee after variable costs

moat: AI-native architecture (MCP server + REST API for agent integration), vertical proof schemas with Claude vision validation, accumulated validation training data, existing Everlight infrastructure (Supabase, Oracle, Stripe, Django) enabling near-zero incremental cost, B2B-first economics with higher LTV than consumer gig platforms

competitors.name: TaskRabbit
competitors.weakness: Consumer-focused, no API, no AI integration, no proof validation layer

competitors.name: RentAHuman.ai
competitors.weakness: Generic, not verticalized, no structured proof schemas, early stage

competitors.name: Thumbtack
competitors.weakness: Service marketplace, not task marketplace, no B2B API

competitors.name: Gigwalk
competitors.weakness: Retail audit only, legacy platform, no AI agent integration

competitors.name: Field Agent
competitors.weakness: Retail/CPG only, enterprise-only pricing, no MCP/API-first design

risks.risk: Marketplace chicken-and-egg: no workers without tasks, no tasks without workers
risks.mitigation: Seed 50 workers in 3 cities with guaranteed minimum earnings before opening demand side

risks.risk: Worker safety liability for field tasks
risks.mitigation: Task category restrictions, emergency button, independent contractor ToS, platform liability insurance

risks.risk: Proof fraud by workers submitting fake photos
risks.mitigation: EXIF validation, GPS trail matching, Claude vision analysis, random human spot-checks on 5%
Workers choose tasks, set rates, use own equipment (pass ABC test), consult employment attorney pre-launch

risks.risk: Low initial task volume makes economics unattractive for workers
risks.mitigation: Guaranteed minimum earnings for first 5 tasks, focus on 3 metro areas initially

next_action: Begin Week 1 sprint: Supabase migration + worker signup + landing page
